abstract: Twenty cases of cystic struma ovarii in women aged 23 to 83 (average, 46) years are described. The patients had the usual signs and symptoms of an adnexal mass. The tumors, all of which were unilateral and confined to the ovary, ranged from 2 to 19 (average, 13.5) cm in greatest dimension. Eighteen were multilocular, two unilocular. They were typically filled with clear to green-brown fluid. Microscopic examination showed cysts of various sizes separated by fibrous septa, which in many areas appeared nonspecific, but in all the cases contained at least small numbers of thyroid follicles. The cysts were typically lined by nonspecific-appearing, flat to cuboidal epithelial cells. The paucity of thyroid follicles in many areas and the nonspecific appearance of the epithelial cells lining the cysts often caused the diagnosis of struma ovarii to be overlooked. Clues to the correct diagnosis, in addition to the thyroid follicles in the septa, included the presence of larger areas of typical struma in a few cases and the association with a dermoid cyst in three cases. Immunohistochemical staining for thyroglobulin confirmed the nature of the tumor in all three cases in which it was performed. The diagnosis of cystic struma should be entertained when examining a multilocular or unilocular cystic ovarian neoplasm whose features are not obviously those of another tumor type, and a careful search for thyroid follicles should be undertaken to establish the diagnosis. In problematic cases, immunohistochemical staining for thyroglobulin may be required to establish the diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の症例20例（23〜83歳、平均46歳）を記述する。患者は付属器腫瘤に典型的な徴候や症状を示した。腫瘍はすべて片側性で卵巣に限局し、最大径は2〜19cm（平均13.5cm）であった。18例は多房性、2例は単房性であった。典型的には透明から緑褐色の液体で満たされていた。顕微鏡検査では、線維性隔壁で区切られたさまざまな大きさの嚢胞を認めた。隔壁の多くの部位は非特異的な所見であったが、全症例で少数ながら甲状腺濾胞を含んでいた。甲状腺濾胞の乏しい部位や嚢胞内面を覆う非特異的な扁平〜立方上皮は、しばしば診断の見落としの原因となった。診断の手がかりとしては、隔壁内の甲状腺濾胞に加え、数例では典型的な甲状腺組織のより広い領域があったこと、3例では類皮嚢腫の合併があった。サイログロブリン免疫染色は、施行した3例すべてで腫瘍の性質を確認した。多房性または単房性の嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍で、他の腫瘍型の所見が明らかでない場合には嚢胞性甲状腺腫を考慮し、甲状腺濾胞を注意深く探すべきである。診断に問題がある症例では、サイログロブリンの免疫染色が診断の確定に必要となることがある。
